name: JA_CN_VAT_LINES_ALL
description: This table contains VAT invoice line information.

columns.name: VAT_TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Surrogate key that identifies a row in this table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VAT_TRX_HEADER_ID
columns.description: VAT invoice transaction header identifier.

columns.name: GTA_TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Golden Tax transaction line identifier.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Indicates line number of a VAT invoice.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: MATCHED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a transaction line is mapped to the VAT invoice line.

columns.name: ITEM_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Inventory item description on a VAT invoice line.

columns.name: ITEM_MODEL
columns.description: Inventory item model on a VAT invoice line.

columns.name: ITEM_TAX_DENOMINATION
columns.description: Inventory item tax denomination on a VAT invoice line.

columns.name: TAX_RATE
columns.description: Tax rate for a VAT invoice tax.

columns.name: UOM_NAME
columns.description: Unit of measure for an item on a VAT invoice line.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity of an item on a VAT invoice line.

columns.name: PRICE_FLAG
columns.description: Total price of an item on a VAT invoice line.

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Unit price of an item on a VAT invoice line.

columns.name: NET_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount net of tax of a VAT invoice.

columns.name: TAX_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total tax amount of a VAT invoice.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the VAT invoice line has a discount.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
